clauseTitle: Profanity in the title or thumbnail
clauseText: Strong or moderate profanity placed in the title or the thumbnail image is excluded from ad inventory regardless of the advertiser settings.
evidence: this patch is a fucking disaster
rationale: Strong profanity on a packaging surface. This rule survived the July 2025 relaxation.

clauseText: Content in which profanity is the focus, or in which it is used repeatedly or throughout, may not be suitable for all advertisers. This is about frequency and focus across the video, not about any single word.
evidence: the same fucking bug, shipped twice, in the same fucking quarter
rationale: Four strong terms across the span, eight per minute against a clause threshold of four.

clauseText: Content focused on a recent tragedy, a mass-casualty event or a major terrorist act is generally not eligible for ad revenue, even where the treatment is respectful or purely factual.
evidence: the gunman was named on Sunday and the death toll has been revised twice
rationale: Five distinct topic terms sustained across a sixty second window.
